50 years of craft.

div.p: CORDAGE began in 1971 as a small dockside supplier in Portsmouth — coiling and cutting rope for fishermen and harbor workers. Every customer came through the door and knew us by name.
Fifty years later, we serve engineers, riggers, marine operators, climbers, and makers across the globe. Our range has grown, but the standard has not moved a millimetre.
